instructions:
1. Stand on one leg and hold a sturdy support with both hands for balance.
2. Extend the other leg straight forward and keep it off the floor.
3. Bend the standing hip and knee to lower slowly, keeping your chest up and the free leg straight.
4. Descend until your glutes are near your heel.
5. Push through the heel to stand back up, switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lower under control and do not collapse at the bottom.
2. Keep the free leg straight and roughly parallel to the floor.
3. Use the support only for balance, not to pull yourself up.
4. Keep weight on the mid-foot and heel of the working leg.

instructions:
1. Kneel on the assisted pull-up machine pad and grip the handles overhand, just wider than shoulder-width.
2. Let your arms extend fully and your shoulder blades rise.
3. Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar, driving the elbows down.
4. Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows tracking down and slightly in, not flared wide.
2. Set the assistance so you can complete clean reps with control.
3. Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower.
4. Pull your shoulder blades down and back at the top.

instructions:
1. Set up in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your body in a straight line.
2. Have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
4. Push through your palms to straighten your arms back to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a straight line from head to heels and brace your core.
2. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.
3. Make sure the plate is centered and secure on the upper back.
4. Keep elbows around 45 degrees, not flared to the sides.

instructions:
1. Lie face down with your lower abdomen on an exercise ball.
2. Plant your feet firmly on the floor with legs extended.
3. Place your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
4. Bend at the waist to lower your upper body over the ball.
5. Squeeze your lower back and glutes to lift your torso until your body is straight.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your feet firmly planted for stability.
2. Lift with your lower back and glutes, not your neck or arms.
3. Do not hyperextend at the top; stop at a straight line.
4. Move slowly and keep the ball steady.

instructions:
1. Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Pull and tuck so your head drops toward the floor and your legs lift overhead.
3. Pass your legs under the bar and lower into a horizontal position.
4. Hold your body straight and parallel to the floor, facing down.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to hold a straight line.
2. Keep your arms straight and your grip firm throughout.
3. Breathe steadily during the hold.
4. Build with tuck and straddle progressions before the full lever.
